case "$2" in
*titled*) printf -- '---
title: "Fancy / Title"
source: x
---

# Heading
body & <tags>
' ;;
*empty-title*) printf -- '---
title: ""
---

# Fallback Heading
body
' ;;
*heading*) printf '# Only Heading

text
' ;;
*fail*) echo boom >&2; exit 3 ;;
*) printf 'plain body without any title
' ;;
esac

home_files.bin/symmemory:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/mem"
mkdir -p "$D"
key() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr ' ' '_'; }
case "$1" in
version) echo '{"tool":"symmemory","version":"1.2.3","schema_version":1}' ;;
entity)
  case "$2" in
  show)
    f="$D/ent_$(key "$3")"
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; echo "relations: none"; else echo "no such entity $3" >&2; exit 1; fi ;;
  add)
    f="$D/ent_$(key "$3")"
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "UNIQUE constraint failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
    n=$(cat "$D/next" 2>/dev/null || echo 100)
    echo $((n+1)) > "$D/next"
    printf '{"id":"ent-%s","name":"%s","type":"%s","aliases":[],"description":""}\n' "$n" "$3" "$5" > "$f"
    echo "added $3" ;;
  list)
    printf '['
    sep=''
    for f in "$D"/ent_*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      printf '%s' "$sep"
      tr -d '\n' < "$f"
      sep=','
    done
    echo ']' ;;
  relate) echo "$3|$4|$5" >> "$D/relations.log"; echo ok ;;
  *) echo "unexpected: $*" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac ;;
set)
  case "$3" in *boom*) echo "set exploded" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
  n=$(cat "$D/memnext" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
  echo $((n+1)) > "$D/memnext"
  echo "$3|$5|$9" >> "$D/set.log"
  printf '{"id":"mem-%s","content":"x","scope":"%s","entities":[]}\n' "$n" "$5" ;;
*) echo "unexpected: $*" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

home_files.bin/symmemory:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/mem"
mkdir -p "$D"
key() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr ' ' '_'; }
case "$1" in
version) echo '{"tool":"symmemory","version":"1.2.3","schema_version":1}' ;;
entity)
  case "$2" in
  show)
    f="$D/ent_$(key "$3")"
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; echo "relations: none"; else echo "no such entity $3" >&2; exit 1; fi ;;
  add)
    f="$D/ent_$(key "$3")"
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "UNIQUE constraint failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
    n=$(cat "$D/next" 2>/dev/null || echo 100)
    echo $((n+1)) > "$D/next"
    printf '{"id":"ent-%s","name":"%s","type":"%s","aliases":[],"description":""}\n' "$n" "$3" "$5" > "$f"
    echo "added $3" ;;
  list)
    printf '['
    sep=''
    for f in "$D"/ent_*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      printf '%s' "$sep"
      tr -d '\n' < "$f"
      sep=','
    done
    echo ']' ;;
  relate) echo "$3|$4|$5" >> "$D/relations.log"; echo ok ;;
  *) echo "unexpected: $*" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac ;;
set)
  case "$3" in *boom*) echo "set exploded" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
  n=$(cat "$D/memnext" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
  echo $((n+1)) > "$D/memnext"
  echo "$3|$5|$9" >> "$D/set.log"
  printf '{"id":"mem-%s","content":"x","scope":"%s","entities":[]}\n' "$n" "$5" ;;
*) echo "unexpected: $*" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
